{
  "reviewer": "agy",
  "lens": "correctness+spec",
  "findings": [
    {
      "severity": "medium",
      "file": "scripts/automation/agent_invoke_cli.py",
      "line": 770,
      "finding": "_emit writes and flushes the result document to stdout before attempting to write to output_file.",
      "why": "If output_file is unwritable, _emit raises _OperationalError and main exits with code 1 after already emitting the document to stdout, violating the contract that exit code 1 produces no document.",
      "suggestion": "Write to output_file before writing to sys.stdout.buffer so that any write failure aborts before stdout is populated."
    },
    {
      "severity": "medium",
      "file": "scripts/automation/agent_invoke_cli.py",
      "line": 549,
      "finding": "_matched_files_digest includes the relative file path rel in the hashed payload.",
      "why": "This directly contradicts the spec and docstring stating that the digest is over file bytes and that a file rename with unchanged content must not invalidate the digest.",
      "suggestion": "Hash only the sorted list of content hashes (file_hash) without pairing them with their paths rel if path independence is intended, or align the docstring and spec with path inclusion."
    },
    {
      "severity": "medium",
      "file": "scripts/automation/agent_invoke_cli.py",
      "line": 794,
      "finding": "_emit_preflight_document hardcodes matched_files_sha256 to None in both the input digest computation and the input block.",
      "why": "When caller provides --matched-file and a preflight check fails (such as P7 require_env_auth or P8 cli_unavailable), predicate_matched_files is recorded but matched_files_sha256 is null, causing digest mismatch with post-launch documents.",
      "suggestion": "Pass resolved_root to _emit_preflight_document and compute _matched_files_digest(resolved_root, matched_files) when matched_files is non-empty."
    },
    {
      "severity": "low",
      "file": "scripts/automation/agent_invoke_cli.py",
      "line": 750,
      "finding": "model_source is unconditionally set to 'agent_frontmatter' when --model is absent, even if the agent frontmatter contains no model field.",
      "why": "When an agent frontmatter omits model, model_value is null but model_source is recorded as 'agent_frontmatter', falsely attributing a nonexistent setting.",
      "suggestion": "Set model_source to 'cli_override' if args.model else ('agent_frontmatter' if model_value else None)."
    },
    {
      "severity": "low",
      "file": "scripts/automation/agent_invoke_cli.py",
      "line": 628,
      "finding": "_validate_and_normalize_args does not verify that --not-applicable provides a non-empty reason string.",
      "why": "Passing --not-applicable '' produces an applicability_reason with an empty string, violating the requirement (§4.2) that applicability_reason be mandatory and non-empty.",
      "suggestion": "Reject empty or whitespace-only strings for --not-applicable with a _UsageError in _validate_and_normalize_args."
    }
  ],
  "verdict": "request_changes",
  "summary": "The implementation cleanly structures the L2/L3 CLI and shell wrappers and thoroughly covers the classifier decision matrix with extensive tests. However, changes are requested to address contract and spec gaps: _emit flushes stdout before verifying output file writability (violating the no-document promise on exit code 1), _matched_files_digest includes relative paths contrary to the documented rename-invariance rule, _emit_preflight_document omits matched files digest calculation on preflight failures, and model_source falsely reports agent_frontmatter when no model key is present."
}
